# Column masking

## Summary

AcmeLake can mask sensitive columns dynamically at query time. Administrators define masking rules
per column and per group, and masked values are replaced with hashes or partial values in query
results.

## Details

- Per-column masking rules.
- Masked values are hashed or partially shown.
